suite: Tier 1: Feature Coverage - Negative Prompting & Anti-Artifact Vectors

tests.name: Anti-Artifact Vector for Clean Acoustic Recording
tests.style_of_music: ukrainian acoustic indie folk, fingerstyle acoustic guitar, close warm female vocal, natural wood percussion, 105 bpm
tests.exclude: metallic treble, harsh frequencies, digital clipping, muddy bass, reverb wash, compressed mp3 artifacts
tests.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Тихий ранок торкається вікон,
Сонце падає на дерев'яну підлогу.

tests.name: Anti-Genre Clash Suppression for Intimate Neoclassical
tests.style_of_music: ukrainian neoclassical chamber, acoustic bandura, solo cello, minimal ambient room tone, 68 bpm
tests.exclude: heavy metal distortion, trap 808 bass, autotune, edm build-up, aggressive drums, electric brass
tests.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Solo Bandura]

[Verse 1]
Срібні струни мовчать у півтемряві.

tests.name: Anti-Mud and Anti-Distortion Vector for Clean Synthwave
tests.style_of_music: ukrainian modern synth-pop, clean punchy bass, crisp analog leads, clear airy female vocal, 122 bpm
tests.exclude: muddy sub frequencies, garbled audio, distorted vocals, room echo, mono audio, tape degradation
tests.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Світло неону веде нас у ніч,
(тільки вперед)

tests.name: Anti-Speech Clutter for Instrumental Atmosphere
tests.style_of_music: cinematic ukrainian ambient, atmospheric drone, bowing cello, shimmering bandura harmonics, slow tempo, 55 bpm
tests.exclude: spoken dialogue, crowd chatter, laughing, cheering, whispering voices, singing, percussion

tests.name: Anti-Kitsch and Anti-Polka Vector for Serious Modern Ethno
tests.style_of_music: dark ukrainian ethno, deep frame drum, polyphonic female chant, gritty cello ostinato, 118 bpm
tests.exclude: tourist accordion, generic polka, happy synthesizer brass, comedy vocal inflections, fast synth arpeggio
tests.lyrics:
[Intro]
(гучний бубон)

[Verse 1]
Ой вставала хмара чорна над горою.
